Lead executive business reviews with evidence of partner impact

Coordinate expansion with Sales and implementation handoffs
Coach assigned Partner Operations Managers and maintain CRM records

Institutional account maps, renewal calendar, baseline health scorecard
Build segment-specific QBR templates and intervention playbooks with the Sales and Operations teams
Executive review packs, retention risk triage and measurable partnership impact
Pilot account reviews and forecast renewals; assess expansion only when partner value is evidenced
90-day renewal forecast, risk register, partner success operating cadence
